sloka: ततः सुपर्णः काकुत्स्थौ दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यभिनन्दितः ।विममर्श च पाणिभ्यां मुखे चन्द्रसमप्रभे ।। ६.५०.३८ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ suparṇaḥ kākutsthau dṛṣṭvā pratyabhinanditaḥ ।vimamarśa ca pāṇibhyāṁ mukhe candrasamaprabhe ।। 6.50.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Garuda paying his respects to the noble Rama and Lakshmana, touching their feet, wiped their face which shone like the moon.
